name: Hear Me, Hear You
source: Experience a josei body horror adventure game that will make your skin crawl. You are Sage, an average thirty something woman living in the cyberpunk city of Blore. As you leave from work, you are attacked by a parasitic creature that claims to know everything about you. What will you do? Embrace the creature or try to remove it? Like anything in life, your choices affect everyone around you. Should you keep letting others decide your fate? Or do you take chances just to experience your own downfall?
translation: 体验一场让你起鸡皮疙瘩的上生身体恐怖冒险游戏。你是Sage，一位生活在赛博朋克城市布洛尔的平均三十多岁的女性。当你下班时，你遭到了一种声称了解你一切的寄生生物的攻击。你会怎么做？拥抱该生物还是尝试将其移走？就像生活中的任何事情一样，你的选择会影响你周围的每个人。你应该继续让别人决定你的命运吗？或者你会冒险只是为了经历自己的失败吗？
